question: Can the Path 2 phi ODE be replaced with a closed-form elliprj evaluation (incomplete elliptic integral of the third kind), keeping accuracy within the 1e-9 gate while meeting the Pool(24) <=5 ms/candidate budget?
hypothesis: Replacing solve_ivp(phi_dot) with scipy.special.elliprj (Carlson R_J per DLMF 19.25.14) removes the ODE, retains 1e-9 q accuracy and machine-precision conservation, and brings Pool(24) per-candidate wall under 5 ms.
narrative_md: Replaced solve_ivp(phi_dot) in propagate_jacobi_path2 with a closed-form elliprj+elliprf evaluation of Pi(n; am(tau)|m) (DLMF 19.25.14), now the default with the ode path retained as fallback. All four gates pass: worst q-vs-DOP853 7.97e-11, worst conservation 4.70e-14, Pool(24) median 4.76 ms (<=5 ms target). Single-process wall drops 16.4->4.0 ms on seed 89, up to 47x on fast tumblers. The hot path shifts to the per-epoch reconstruction loop. Validates vs cached truth -> oracle_clean false.
